# Project skill set

These project-local skills were selected for `rote-mappe` from
[`sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills`](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills)
and pinned to upstream commit `00f9c4077878be6ffcc093c099f05a6cccaf1b95`.

| Skill | Purpose | Upstream risk |
|---|---|---|
| `playwright-skill` | Browser workflows, responsive checks, screenshots, and upload/import flows | critical |
| `accessibility-compliance-accessibility-audit` | WCAG-scoped keyboard, focus, form, contrast, and screen-reader audits | safe |
| `javascript-testing-patterns` | Vitest/React Testing Library/E2E test strategy | safe |
| `security-and-hardening` | Defensive review of local data, file inputs, untrusted content, and headers | critical |
| `frontend-design` | Responsive, accessible, coherent visual design work | critical |
| `performance-optimization` | Measure-first performance and Core Web Vitals workflow | critical |

Review each `SKILL.md` before execution. The critical-risk skills contain
guidance for commands or code that may have filesystem, browser, or network
effects; use them only within this repository and with synthetic test data.
